title: fix(auth): confirmation recovery and shared-network sign-up
body:
## HUNT-02-124, agent 124 — T4 authentication recovery

### Findings
- **B-HUNT02-1:** The sixth ordinary email signup on the same Wi-Fi is refused for an hour even though the app explicitly offers signup without an invite code.
- **B-HUNT02-2:** A customer whose confirmation email is missing or expired cannot request another confirmation link from either the verification screen or an unconfirmed sign-in.
- **U-HUNT02-1:** A room of 40 ordinary password sign-ins exceeds the existing 20/minute IP allowance; the default becomes 60/minute, keeping 200/hour and the per-account failure lock unchanged.
- **U-HUNT02-2:** Standard email whitespace is rejected by DTO validation before the existing normalizer can run; normalize before IsEmail, preserving plus suffixes.

### Fix
Bounded codeless signup default100/hour/IP (`AUTH_SIGNUP_PER_HOUR`, clamped5..500), preserving bootstrap-owner's5/hour, OAuth coach-creation ceiling, invite validation and password-account lock. New independently throttled anonymous resend endpoint uses the existing signup redirect. Same submission response for unknown/confirmed/unconfirmed accounts and mail refusal; no delivery claim, account lookup, token or raw provider-error exposure. Additive policy capability keeps upgraded mobile compatible with older backends.

### Failing first and checks
- Test-first commit98ca5720; one extra CI lane only: https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37522256706 — all11 new cases failed for the actual missing endpoint/normalization and restrictive limits, not compilation.
- Added regression coverage for shared-network room intake, finite caps, plus/case/space email, anonymous resend, delivery wording and safe logging. Preserve owner bootstrap ceiling and endpoint bucket isolation.
- PR's own CI supplies fixed-head typecheck/full regression proof. Local backend dependency installation timed out; no local full suites or project tsc.
- No production writes, signups, provider calls, dashboard changes, merging, deployment or spending.

### Owner settings and recommended defaults
Verify custom SMTP/auth-email capacity100/hour without a paid-plan change, and Supabase sign-up/sign-in limit100 per5minutes where existing plan permits. Supabase's upstream settings are unknown and independent of application IP limits. Confirm email remains enabled. Existing exact confirmation/reset redirect allow-list is owned by HUNT-01.

Needs both backend T4 lenses at the exact head; do not deploy from this PR.
